body:
I saved the cloth with white crystals for you. The seed trial crew passed Monday morning; my eyes began burning, and afterward the county van arrived.

I carried it home because there was nowhere open to return it. The mark did not come off when I tried to wash my hands.

When I returned, the window was closed and the board was blank. I kept the page because it was the only one with our address.
title: Monday morning — white crystals
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same white crystals while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
